architect.reply_head:
Yes

The design is minimal: one Experimental entry is tuned, no new record type or checker rule is added, and the check is an existing `git merge-base --is-ancestor` line with its exit status in the gate record. It can be enforced mechanically without false positives.

Notes, which do not change my vote:
- "Every other review of the page" is judged by a person, not a checker. The facilitator should list the reviews in the gate record so the ancestor check has a named last report to compare against.
- The two metrics are sound. The counter-metric guards against the rule slowing docs cards down.
